scope: Independent re-check of nine thesis tables (Polatides 2007 Tables 5.1, 5.14, 5.21, 7.24; Katsounaros 2009 Tables 6.11, 7.7, 8.5; Dortsiou 2009 Tables 6.1, 5.1) and of data/evidence/tin_series_thesis_notes.json (T1-T67).

sources.text_layers: National Archive of PhD Theses online-reader per-page text layers (session scratch, not committed); page offsets printed = reader - 21 (Polatides, eadd/15209), - 30 (Katsounaros, eadd/19491), - 36 (Dortsiou, eadd/27551)
sources.translation: Greek read and translated by the verifier

method: Tables: each table body cut from the page text, rows parsed with the verifier's own layout regex, tidy rows rebuilt and compared cell by cell (printed string, numeric value and row keys) with extracted.csv; layout tested by row sums, sign/offset relations, header subscript order, text quotes, cross-table values and repository figure digitizations; every meta printed_sequence re-searched. Claims: automated scan of every quoted number on the cited printed pages for all 67 claims, plus manual reading and translation of all 67 against the pages. The transcriber's scripts were not used.

overall_issues.issue: Note says "the text says gaseous selectivity came from the mass balance"; the text says so only for graphite, and repeats Pb 31,18 % itself. NH3 68,49 is corroborated by Table 5.21 (68,5). Flag is right, note wording should be narrowed.

The gloss that the 70 % nitramide share is "a remainder after the hydroxylamine share (10 %) and the hyponitrite evidence" is a fair reading of "the remaining about 70 %", but no hyponitrite share is given in the pages read (100 - 10 = 90), so the arithmetic behind 70 % is not reproducible. Suggest saying the thesis gives no derivation.
"-2.24 V vs Ag/AgCl (Diag 6.6, Diag 9.2)": the Diag 9.2 caption prints "-2,24 V" without a reference electrode.

The second cross-reference "slip" ("(5.24) has no participation" where (5.21) is meant) is an interpretation; the sentence can be read as the Angeli/HNO route as a whole not taking part. The first slip ((5.23) for the Angeli decomposition) is clear.

fixes_note: No unambiguous typo was found in the nine extracted.csv files, their meta.json files or the claims file; all issues above are wording or interpretation and were reported, not edited.
limitations: Verification is against the same online-reader text layers the transcriber used; page images were not viewed, so a misprint that is consistent across text layer and image, or a text-layer glyph substitution (e.g. U+2126 OHM SIGN for capital omega in Dortsiou p. 91), cannot be detected by this check beyond the internal-consistency tests.
Cross-checks against figures (Diag 5.8, 6.4, 6.6, 6.7, 9.3, 9.6, 10.6) use earlier repository digitizations; they were not re-digitized here.
Claims T36, T49 and T51 were checked only in part (listed per claim); absence claims (T3, T48) were checked by reading the cited chapters, which cannot prove absence elsewhere in the thesis.
